object.attr: stakeholder: an object ID names one object for good, because links on other branches, history, Compare and issued PDFs refer to it. Fixing ID reuse was decided on 2026-11-06 (open question Q7). A number one side used and deleted must not go to the renumbered object.
object.description: When Mellon renumbers an object while resolving a merge, Mellon shall give the object a number no lower than either side's next object number.
